hooks.name: Air-Gap Save Check
hooks.description: After a file under src/ is saved, run the air-gap source scan (npm run airgap) and report any forbidden network identifiers (Requirement 8.1).

action.prompt: A file under src/ was just saved. Run `npm run airgap` from the repository root to scan src/ for the forbidden network identifiers (fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket, EventSource, sendBeacon, RTCPeerConnection). If the scan passes, reply with one line saying the air-gap check passed. If it fails, list each violation as `file:line` followed by the forbidden word that matched, and suggest renaming or removing it (for example `loadSamples` instead of `fetchSamples`). Do not print the content of the offending lines or any other file content, because files under src/ can hold Plaintext, Passwords, or key material. Do not change any files unless the user asks you to.
